class.name: CitySim
class.brief_description: The game's connection to the C++ simulation.
class.description: The one node GDScript uses to control and observe the simulation (architecture §11). The game wraps it in the autoload [code]Sim[/code]. It owns the running game: the loaded content and the simulation thread. GDScript submits commands as dictionaries, which are validated in C++, and reads statistics and signals; it never touches simulation state. Call it from the main thread only.

method.name: get_core_version
method.description: Returns the version of the simulation core library, for example [code]0.0.1[/code].

method.name: get_channel
method.description: Returns the snapshot channel called [param name] as a flat array of records, or an empty array if there is none. For debugging: the fast renderers read channels in C++ without copying. The built-in channel [code]debug.clock[/code] has one record of three numbers: tick, speed and paused (0 or 1).

method.name: get_interpolation_alpha
method.description: Returns how far between the previous and the current simulation snapshot it is time to draw this frame, from 0.0 to 1.0. It is 1.0 while the game is paused and when no game runs. It is computed once per frame, so everything drawn in a frame agrees.

method.name: get_stats
method.description: Returns [code]{tick, tps, tick_ms_avg, tick_ms_last, entity_count, speed, paused, date_text, time_text}[/code] from the newest snapshot. All numbers are 0 and the texts empty before a game starts.

method.name: is_running
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while a game started with [method new_game] is running.

method.name: new_game
method.description: Loads the content found under [param content_roots] ([code]res://[/code] and [code]user://[/code] paths are fine), starts a game in the era [param era_id] and its simulation thread, replacing a running game. [param enabled_mods] lists the mods to load; empty means the ones enabled by default. Returns [code]{ok, errors, warnings}[/code]; on failure [code]errors[/code] says what is wrong and no game is running.

method.name: shutdown
method.description: Stops the simulation thread and ends the game. Does nothing if no game is running.

method.name: submit_command
method.description: Validates [param command] in C++ and queues it for the next tick. Returns [code]false[/code], after printing the reason with [method @GlobalScope.push_error], if it was not accepted. Commands: [code]{"type": "set_speed", "speed": 1..3}[/code], [code]{"type": "toggle_pause"}[/code], [code]{"type": "set_era", "era_id": "base:era.modern"}[/code], [code]{"type": "save_game", "path": "user://saves/a.csav"}[/code] and [code]{"type": "load_game", "path": "..."}[/code]. [code]true[/code] means queued, not done: the result of a save or load arrives as a signal.

signal.name: date_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the calendar day changes, with the date written in the current language.

signal.name: load_completed
signal.description: Emitted when a [code]load_game[/code] command has finished. [param message] is the failure reason, or the warnings (for example that the content changed since the save) when [param ok] is [code]true[/code].

signal.name: save_completed
signal.description: Emitted when a [code]save_game[/code] command, or an autosave, has finished. [param message] is the failure reason when [param ok] is [code]false[/code].

signal.name: speed_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the game speed or the pause state changes (and once when a game starts).

signal.name: tick_advanced
signal.description: Emitted when the simulation has advanced to [param tick] since the last frame. Several ticks can pass between two frames.
